// diagnostic E2418

Jet.ErrorConversionCycle

Error conversion cycle: `impl {target}.From({source})` would make conversion loop

What

Error conversion cycle: `impl {target}.From({source})` would make conversion loop

Why

Error conversions must form an acyclic route so a failure has one finite meaning.

Fix

Remove this edge or choose a target that is not already reachable back to the source.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.ErrorConversionCycle: Tests/UI/e2418_error_conv_cycle.stderr.
